## Triage — task 10371 (2026-11-05)

**Verdict: live, well-scoped design issue; no pack-format spec has landed. Keep #6005 OPEN.**

Evidence checked against current main (f0fa32003fe5399ff6bc117d08ecc80a7322250d, equal to origin/main):

- #6005 is OPEN and has no linked PR. The checkout contains no full moderation-pack schema/versioning/parameter spec. Existing board moderation is board-specific (pkgs/id/src/boards.rs:183-229), not a reusable pack.
- The merged #6006 feed-protocol note (doc/2026-11-05T13-36-21Z_design_threat_list_feed_protocol/) defines feed subscriptions and local overrides, but explicitly defers the pack-side subscription parameter. It is an input to this spec, not a duplicate.
- The parent moderation-library design #5973 and capability model #5958 remain OPEN. KDL profile #5753 and writer-set authority #5545 are also OPEN. Current pkgs/id world manifest parsing is TOML (pkgs/id/src/world_manifest.rs); KDL is a proposed profile, not current pack support.

**Fix path:** one dated design note under doc/<UTC>_design_moderation_pack_format/ defining the pack’s static policy core, versioning/compatibility, feed references aligned with #6006, and a separate per-world parameter surface (quarantine threshold, moderator/reviewer set, local exemptions). Make the serialization/profile choice explicit rather than implying KDL is already implemented. Keep the feed protocol itself in #6006 and preset tier values in #6007.

**Ordering:** settle or explicitly coordinate the pack/library interface and parameter names with #5973 (and its #5958 capability boundary); align the serialization choice with #5753; reuse #6006’s signed-feed contract. #6007 should define tier defaults against the resulting parameter names, or state draft names if it proceeds concurrently. These are design dependencies, not a reason to split #6005 or close it. No follow-up task is needed: #6005 itself is the design deliverable.
